mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 (YoY), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in unemployment signals labor market improvement boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5 and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals manufacturing contraction reducing corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% YoY), a decline in quarterly GDP growth signals economic slowdown triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% (YoY) and GDPC1 growth declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
